title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 11–39 years (¥250bn anticipated) — the only JGB supply event the market itself allocates, and the one that straddles both BoJ buckets
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 24,854 bytes) for this initial research; its table row reads 'Oct. 27, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 11-39 years)'. The DATE is MOF's own. The ¥250bn SIZE is anticipated, not announced: NO row on the October calendar carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09, and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms ~2026-10-20. The anticipated size comes from MOF primaries — the last six super-long Liquidity Enhancement Auctions were all struck at about ¥250bn (result pages eresul20251023, 20251223, 20260225, 20260421, 20260604, 20260814, each HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-09: accepted ¥248.1 / 249.8 / 249.2 / 249.8 / 249.8 / 248.9bn), and the 2026-08-14 announcement auct20260807e.htm prints 'Offering Amount | About 250 billion yen'. CADENCE IS BI-MONTHLY AND UNBROKEN across a zone redefinition: MOF's own monthly calendars 2024-02 → 2026-11 place the super-long Liquidity Enhancement Auction in every even month with no exception (2026-04-21, 06-04, 08-14, 10-27; November 2026 carries only the 1-5y and 5-11y zones). Filed `estimate` on three counts: the size is anticipated rather than announced, the reopened-issue list does not exist until MOF's own 'Issues Re-opened' page publishes on the day, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed 2026-09-08 by the jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 initial-research adjacency sweep (proposals/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27.from-jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08.json, read as input and now shadowed by this canonical file); researched 2026-09-09 (docs/research/events/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27.md). THE INSTRUMENT WAS REDEFINED FIVE MONTHS AGO, WHICH IS THE HEADLINE. MOF's own calendars show the super-long Liquidity Enhancement zone was '15.5-39 years' through 2026-02-25 and '11-39 years' from 2026-04-21 — so this auction has exactly THREE prints under its current definition and no distribution to calibrate against. The 30-year sibling's rule ('compute the tenor's own distribution before applying anyone's threshold') reaches its limit here: there is no distribution yet. WHAT MAKES THE EVENT WORTH TRACKING IS THAT BIDDERS, NOT MOF, CHOOSE THE BONDS. The announcement names a maturity band and one total offering amount; the 'Issues Re-opened' page reports ex post which off-the-run issues the market actually took, 10 to 36 of them per auction. That makes it the only JGB supply event on this calendar whose result is a direct read on WHERE inside the super-long curve demand sits. THE READ IS UNAMBIGUOUS AND NEW: all three 11-39y auctions reopened ZERO 20-year issues — 0.0% of ¥249.8 / ¥249.8 / ¥248.9bn — even though 20-year issues No.162-196 are explicitly listed as eligible and are 36.3% of the ¥321.9tn eligible in-band outstanding. Under the old 15.5-39y zone the 20-year share ran 63.7% → 32.6% → 35.3% → 89.0% → 14.6% → 4.0% → 4.1% → 4.0% → 11.4% before hitting zero, and widening the band to 11 years ADDED 20-year eligibility (24.5% → 36.8% of stock) while takeup fell to nothing. Purchases skew the other way: the 25y+ share of reopenings ran 1.41x / 1.34x / 1.87x its share of eligible stock. IT ALSO CLOSES THE 30-YEAR LEDGER'S OWN STATED LIMIT — that ledger excluded Liquidity Enhancement supply from its BoJ absorption arithmetic and flagged the exact percentages as unreliable. Including it, the BoJ's share of 25y+ supply is 11.3% (2024-02) → 18.4% (2026-08) rather than ~12% → ~20%, and its share of 10-25y supply is 35.2% → 20.6% rather than ~45% → ~29%. The DIRECTION survives; the 2026 LEVEL gap between the two buckets collapses from ~9pp to 2.2pp. AND THE CURVE KINK IS AT 25 YEARS, NOT 30: on MOF's own par curve 20s25s is +25.7bp (93.5th percentile of 4,607 sessions, median +12.7) while 25s30s is -1.3bp (1.2nd percentile, median +8.1) and 30s40s +0.4bp (1.7th) — the kink sits exactly on the BoJ's own 25-year bucket boundary, which the sibling could not see because it never read the 25-year point. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` for the same reasons every JGB entry records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and the JGB-to-US-long-end channel was refuted under control at the 30-year. The auction sits one day before fomc-2026-10-28 and three before boj-decision-2026-10-30, and shares its date with treasury-buyback-20y30y-2026-10-27 — the closest structural analogue on the calendar, with Treasury BUYING back off-the-run 20-30y paper the same day MOF SELLS it. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
